worldcombat.skill.uproar.summary: Shout several times, sending rings of sound out from yourself into nearby foes; while the uproar lasts, nobody who hears it can fall asleep. Each ring spreads from wherever you are, so standing close covers a foe; step away and it fades.
worldcombat.skill.uproar.use.0: Hit everyone around you while surrounded
worldcombat.skill.uproar.use.1: Deny the enemy sleep and recovery
worldcombat.skill.uproar.use.2: Shake off the foes clinging to you
worldcombat.skill.uproar.description.0: Each sound wave deals about %1$s special damage to every foe in its radius, for %2$s waves in all.
worldcombat.skill.uproar.description.1: The sound rings out from wherever you stand, %1$s blocks in radius, pushing one ring every %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.uproar.description.2: The no-sleep range is %1$s blocks (centred on you and moving with you): from the first shout until the uproar ends, nobody inside can fall asleep, and anyone already asleep inside when it starts is woken. If the uproar status is dispelled early, the sound stops with it.
worldcombat.skill.uproar.preference.sust: On: one extra wave, longer cooldown and a slower windup, holding more foes in the ring for longer. Off: three waves and out, faster and cheaper.
worldcombat.skill.uproar.preference.ai.m: The companion only considers an uproar while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger starts chasing in.
The companion only shouts with at least this many enemies inside the sound radius; 1 means shout on sight.
worldcombat.skill.uproar.preference.ai.l: When on, the companion may leave its post to push into a crowd under a Hold or Stay order.
